Paragraphe · It’s kind of surprising, but sometimes t
settings.text: It’s kind of surprising, but sometimes the healthiest habits you think you have – your daily multivitamins and those green smoothies – might not be giving your body everything it truly needs. Why is that?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Most multi vitamins contain nutrients th
settings.text: Most multi vitamins contain nutrients that have been taken out of their natural food sources.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · But in nature, nutrients NEVER exist alo
settings.text: But in nature, nutrients NEVER exist alone. They come in complete packages with natural cofactors and enzymes that work together to support your body.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our ancestors understood this instinctiv
settings.text: Our ancestors understood this instinctively. The proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals in organ meats come together in unique combinations that have been part of traditional diets throughout human history.
